title: The loop removes an ended attempt's worktree that holds read-only directories, and retries a failed removal
description: Runs the loop's real cycle against a real temporary Postgres over an ended attempt's worktree holding a nested 0555 npm tree and a symlink to a read-only directory outside it: an injected first removal failure is retried on the next cycle, which removes the tree without following or chmodding the symlink's target (GY-3226).
